capabilities: Add replace controls to native Search result rows
Preview and apply bulk replacements from the command palette
Infer replacement targets from quoted, regex, and single-token searches
Follow the native Search case-sensitivity state
Write changes through Vault.process() with pre-save recomputation
extras: The manifest carries the warning "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff"; installation is manual from GitHub releases. The README notes the plugin depends on internal SearchView data because no public extension API exists for Search results.
intentEvidence: Replacement controls integrated into Obsidian's built-in Search tab.
problem: Obsidian's core Search finds text but offers no replace workflow, so users must edit matches by hand or rely on external tools.
summary: Search-replace add-on that puts per-file and per-match replace controls into Obsidian's built-in Search tab results.
